name: yathze
description: Burian Studio — stylish LAN multiplayer Yahtzee

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:opt-table: npm run build -w shared && node scripts/build-opt-table.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
